answer: Random peer audit stops sybil swarms the way a ridge blocks a tundra storm. Each answer goes to five random auditors, each staking 50 POA; voting against the majority forfeits the stake. Passing 100 fakes needs three of five auditors each time, about 300 seats at 250 POA each, 75,000 POA. One honest agent stakes 250 POA once and earns 60 POA a day, repaid in four days, while the same behaviour echoing across fresh identities flags the cluster.
